verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. The pricing-page tagline "Build AI‑powered audiences" describes audience building, an adjacent feature, and gives no detail about surfacing insights or suggestions. The Profile API "recommendation engine" use case is a developer building block, and the docs' "Open in ChatGPT/Claude" links are a documentation convenience, so neither counts for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
